title: Magician1.5 elemental mastery event
summary: Defeat successive elemental splits to expose the Essence of Air again.
overview: Defeat successive elemental splits to expose the Essence of Air again.

sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: The eligible magician activates the encounter by reaching its hidden trigger.
At 80%, 60%, 40%, 20% and 10%, the essence disappears and summons a larger set of lesser essences.
Kill every essence of the current set to make the boss return.
Tanks should rebuild threat after each return; complete the sequence inside thirty minutes.

notes: Reviewed quest source; behavior, balance, spawns and completion have not been verified in a live instance.
